critical_findings.title: Four consecutive tagged releases never published to GitHub
critical_findings.fix: Publish staged v0.26.0 assets via gh release create; backfill or document v0.23-v0.25; add a post-release guard asserting gh release view <tag> succeeds

critical_findings.title: make dist tars docs/ (containing transcripts with AWS keys) into release archives
critical_findings.fix: Remove ../docs/ from the dist target; retire the duplicate Makefile release path in favor of goreleaser

critical_findings.title: GETTING_STARTED.md install one-liner points at dead CosmoDev-R2Go2 repo
critical_findings.fix: Repoint to CosmoLabs-org/cosmoflare/main/install.sh and surface the one-liner in README.md

critical_findings.title: Dead CI workflows remain armed and contradict the local release flow (version string diverges: v0.26.0 vs 0.26.0)
critical_findings.fix: Delete or stub the three workflow files per the permanent no-CI policy

critical_findings.title: Divergent r2go2-branded Makefile release pipeline (different binary name, asset names, platforms)
critical_findings.fix: Rebase Makefile on BINARY_NAME=cosmoflare with r2go2 symlink; align PLATFORMS with .goreleaser.yaml

critical_findings.title: No package-manager distribution (no Homebrew/Scoop/winget; broken install-brew target; Docker never pushed)
critical_findings.fix: Create CosmoLabs-org/homebrew-tap with a formula driven by release assets; remove install-brew; add Scoop/winget manifests

critical_findings.title: install.sh accepts linux/armv7 which no build pipeline produces (download 404)
critical_findings.fix: Drop armv7l from detection with an unsupported message, or add goarm 7 to the goreleaser matrix

critical_findings.title: Desktop tier: version skew (0.16.0 vs CLI 0.26.0), unsigned, no updater, sidecar lacks linux/arm64
critical_findings.fix: Add linux/arm64 sidecar triple; write desktop release SOP with version mapping, notarization, and updater artifacts before paid tier

critical_findings.title: Stale R2Go2 branding across distribution metadata (registry description, install.sh, CHANGELOG Unreleased; r2go2 alias not shipped)
critical_findings.fix: Update description/branding, migrate config dir, have install.sh symlink r2go2, and reconcile the stale Unreleased changelog
